bugs.name: Channel search leaves nonmatching channels visible in collection availability
bugs.summary: Searching for Channel-PLN leaves the nonmatching Channel-USD option visible in the collection availability dialog, even after waiting and pressing Enter.
bugs.expected: With `Channel-PLN` entered in the dialog’s “Search through channels” field, only matching channel options should be shown; Channel-USD should be absent.
bugs.actual: The dialog continued to show both Channel-PLN and Channel-USD. This remained visible after waiting six seconds and pressing Enter.
reproSteps: Start signed in as a Catalog administrator using the provided saved authentication state; no credentials are disclosed.
Open /collections/?asc=true&sort=name and create a fresh collection named `collections-search-20260903-8qk2`.
Open the created collection at /collections/Q29sbGVjdGlvbjoxMA%3D%3D and click Manage in the Availability card.
Enter `Channel-PLN` in “Search through channels.” Observe that both Channel-PLN and Channel-USD remain visible; wait six seconds and press Enter, then observe that both are still listed.
Delete the test collection; after refresh it is absent from the collections list.

bugs.name: Second delete attempt after choosing Keep editing fails to resolve the collection
bugs.summary: The first confirmed delete committed before the unsaved-changes prompt was resolved: the UI showed “Deleted collection” while offering “Keep editing.” After choosing Keep editing and returning to the editor, the next confirmed delete failed with “Couldn't resolve to a node,” and the fixture was absent from the collections list.
bugs.expected: Choosing Keep editing in the unsaved-changes prompt should leave the collection available in the editor; a subsequent confirmed delete should remove it and return to the collections list.
bugs.actual: After the first Delete confirmation, the unsaved-changes prompt appeared at the same time as a “Success — Deleted collection” toast. Choosing Keep editing and then Back left the editor on the deleted collection. A second confirmed delete showed “Couldn't resolve to a node: Q29sbGVjdGlvbjoxMQ==” rather than returning to the list. Retrying produced the same error, and the fixture was absent from the collections list.
reproSteps: Using the authenticated Catalog administrator session (loaded from the provided saved authentication state; no manual sign-in), open /collections/?asc=true&sort=name.
Create a fresh collection named collections-mom-20261002-1742 and open its detail page at /collections/Q29sbGVjdGlvbjoxMQ%3D%3D.
Expand SEO and enter “Unsaved collections SEO title” in Search engine title without saving.
Open the collection settings menu, choose Delete collection, and confirm with Delete.
When “Leave without saving changes?” appears, choose Keep editing. Observe the “Deleted collection” success toast, then choose Back in the still-open Delete Collection dialog.
Open the settings menu again, choose Delete collection, and confirm with Delete.
Observe the “Couldn't resolve to a node” error; retry the deletion and verify it fails again. Return to the unfiltered Collections list and verify the fixture is absent.

bugs.name: Collection image-upload error notifications are clipped off-screen on a narrow mobile viewport
bugs.summary: Rejected collection image uploads leave the error-notification text outside the 390×844 viewport, with only clipped red icon slivers visible; the same result persists after refresh and a repeat upload.
bugs.expected: After the .txt file is rejected, the error notification and its explanation are visible within the 390×844 viewport so the user can understand the rejection.
bugs.actual: The upload area returned to its empty state and two red error notifications appeared at the extreme right edge. Only partial red icon slivers were visible; no notification text was visible inside the viewport. They remained clipped for over 30 seconds and reappeared the same way after refreshing and repeating the upload.
reproSteps: Start signed in as the authorized Admin using the provided saved authentication session; set the browser viewport to 390×844.
Open Catalog > Collections at /collections/.
Create a new own collection named collections-mobile-upload-error-20260720-84217 and open its detail page at /collections/Q29sbGVjdGlvbjo0NA%3D%3D.
In the image area labeled “Drag and drop or click to upload,” select a plain-text .txt file containing ordinary text instead of an image.

Observe the settled upload rejection: two error notifications appear clipped at the right edge, with no message text within the viewport. Refresh the collection detail page and repeat the upload; the same clipped notifications reappear.

matchingGuidance.acceptanceScope: Accepted as a valid reference by user instruction; source prerequisites and remaining evidence gaps are retained below.
prerequisites: Mobile viewport; toast width/right inset exceeds available width.

bugs.name: Empty scheduled-publication date silently publishes products and collections immediately
bugs.summary: With Schedule for later checked, leaving or clearing the date saves successfully and converts the item to immediate publication.
bugs.expected: Require a valid future date when Schedule for later is checked, and keep the item unpublished until the date is valid.
bugs.actual: A previously scheduled product with its date cleared saved successfully, then reloaded as Live, Visible and purchasable with scheduling unchecked. Its visible Public API Test returned Purchasable,1variant. A collection changed from unpublished to Published with Schedule for later checked and a blank date likewise became immediately Published after Save/reload. Both paths were reproduced; product future scheduling was restored afterward.
reproSteps: Open a test product assigned to Channel-USD, e.g. QA Catalog Product1009 (product165), and expand the channel visibility controls.
Enable publication and check Schedule for later. Set a future date and save (control path).
Clear the Date input while Schedule for later remains checked, then Save.
Reload and expand Channel-USD: the product is now Live, Visible and purchasable, and Schedule for later is unchecked.
Click the visible Public API Test; it reports Purchasable with1variant.

Repeat on a test collection assigned to Channel-USD (QA catalog collection6): from unpublished, enable Published, check Schedule for later, leave Date empty, and Save. Reload shows immediate Published instead of requiring a date.
